title: Practice 5: Irregular comparatives: лучше, больше, старше

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Which online dictionary do you use most?
exercises.why: **частый → чаще** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.
**младший → младше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: Я думал, эта пара ботинок ___ (долгий) прослужит.
exercises.prompt: I thought this pair of shoes would last longer.
exercises.why: **долгий → дольше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: He tightened his grip on the steering wheel.
exercises.why: **крепкий → крепче** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: The climate here is milder than that of Moscow.
exercises.why: **мягкий → мягче** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Please don't boil the eggs so hard.
exercises.why: **жидкий → пожиже** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: Старая метла каждый угол знает, а новая ___ (чистый) метёт.
exercises.prompt: Old broom knows every corner of a room, but the new cleans better.
exercises.why: **чистый → чище** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: The veil of ignorance is getting thinner.
exercises.why: **тонкий → тоньше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: По этой дороге ездят всё ___ (редкий), и она постепенно зарастает травой.
exercises.prompt: This road is driven on less and less, and it is slowly becoming overgrown with grass.
exercises.why: **редкий → реже** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: Цвета стали ___ (яркий). Итальянский флаг уже не похож на выцветший французский.
exercises.prompt: The colours are richer now. The Italian flag no longer looks like a faded French flag.
exercises.why: **яркий → ярче** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: Прости, Линк, я не даю кредитов. Возвращайся, когда будешь немного... ммм... ___ (богатый)!
exercises.prompt: Sorry Link, I can't give credit. Come back when you're a little... mmm... richer!
exercises.why: **богатый → побогаче** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: Этот новый блендер гораздо ___ (тихий), чем тот, который у нас был до этого.
exercises.prompt: The new blender we got is much quieter than the last one we had.
exercises.why: **тихий → тише** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.
